title: OrderPagedQueryResponse
description: Paginated response containing a list of orders.

Address.description: A postal address with country and optional structured fields.

id.description: Unique identifier for the address within the resource.

firstName.description: First name of the address recipient.

lastName.description: Last name of the address recipient.

streetName.description: Street name component of the address.

streetNumber.description: Street number component of the address.

postalCode.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address.

region.description: Region, state, or province of the address.

email.description: Email address associated with this postal address.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this postal address.

Attribute.description: A name-value pair representing a product attribute as defined by the product type.

name.description: Attribute name as defined in the product type.

value.description: Attribute value. Type depends on the attribute type definition.

Image.description: A product image with URL, dimensions, and optional label.

LineItem.description: A product line item in a cart or order with quantity, pricing, and discount information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the line item within the cart.

productId.description: ID of the product this line item references.

quantity.description: Quantity of this product variant in the cart.

lineItemMode.description: Whether this is a standard or gift line item.

priceMode.description: How the price for this line item is determined.

LocalizedString.description: A map of locale keys to string values used for multilingual content. Keys follow IETF language tag format (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'en-US').

Money.description: A monetary value with currency code and amount in the smallest currency unit.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g., USD, EUR).

centAmount.description: The amount in the smallest indivisible unit of the currency.

fractionDigits.description: Number of fraction digits for the currency. Defaults to 2.

Order.description: An order created from a cart after checkout, containing immutable line items, pricing, and fulfillment data.

version.description: Current version for optimistic concurrency control.

orderNumber.description: User-defined order number for human-readable identification.

customerId.description: ID of the customer who placed the order.

customerEmail.description: Email of the customer at time of order.

orderState.description: Current high-level state of the order.

shipmentState.description: Current fulfillment state of the order.

paymentState.description: Current payment state of the order.

lineItems.description: Line items captured at time of order creation.

customLineItems.description: Custom line items captured at time of order creation.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was created.

lastModifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was last modified.

Price.description: A price entry for a product variant with optional scoping by channel, customer group, country, or validity period.

id.description: System-generated unique identifier for the price.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to scope the price geographically.

validFrom.description: Start of the price validity period.

validUntil.description: End of the price validity period.

ProductVariant.description: A product variant with SKU, attributes, prices, and images.

id.description: Variant ID unique within the product (starting at 1 for master).

sku.description: Stock keeping unit identifier for this variant.

key.description: User-defined unique key for the variant.

prices.description: List of prices for different currencies, channels, and customer groups.

attributes.description: Product attributes as defined by the product type.

images.description: List of images for this variant.

Reference.description: A reference to another resource by its typeId and id.

typeId.description: The type identifier of the referenced resource (e.g., 'product', 'category').

id.description: The system-generated unique identifier of the referenced resource.
